content.description: Oil seal installation diagram showing cut position and tape placement for timing belt case on cylinder block

content.text: 4. IF TIMING BELT CASE IS INSTALLED ON CYLINDER BLOCK (Replacement of pump drive oil seal)

items: (a) As shown in the figure, use a knife to cut off the oil seal lip.
(b) Using a screwdriver, pry out the oil seal.

content.text: NOTE: Be careful not to damage drive shaft. Tape the screwdriver tip.

content.description: Installation diagram showing SST tool being used to install oil seal into timing belt case

items: (c) Check the drive pump shaft where it contacts the oil lip surface for cracks or damage.
(d) Apply MP grease to the oil seal.
(e) Using SST, install the new oil seal.

content.description: Oil seal installation diagram showing cut position for rear oil seal retainer on cylinder block

content.text: 5. IF REAR OIL SEAL RETAINER IS INSTALLED ON CYLINDER BLOCK (Replacement of rear oil seal)

items: (a) As shown in the figure, use a knife to cut off the oil seal lip.
(b) Using a screwdriver, pry out the oil seal.

content.text: NOTE: Be careful not to damage the crankshaft. Tape the screwdriver tip.

content.description: Installation diagram showing SST tool being used to install rear oil seal into cylinder block

items: (c) Check the crankshaft where it contacts the oil lip surface for cracks or damage.
(d) Apply MP grease to the oil seal.
(e) Using SST, install the new oil seal.
